system.description:
This skill only produces an effect when you have two [Shields] equipped in your [Hand Slots]. Bonus from Block Missile skill becomes +1D instead of +2.

(SR 2): Increase one [Shield]'s Physical defense by 3.

A fighting style that stands in front of the enemy with shields in both hands. The figure that repels arrows and catches swords is an immovable iron wall.
